name: National Artificial Intelligence Strategy: Advancing Our Smart Nation Journey (2019)
owner: Smart Nation and Digital Government Office / Ministry of Digital Development and Information, Singapore
description: Singapore National AI Strategy (NAIS 1.0, launched November 13, 2019). Singapore's national blueprint for artificial intelligence development, deployment, compute infrastructure, talent, and trusted AI governance.
relationToCloudSecurity: Defines national cybersecurity, critical infrastructure protection, and digital sovereignty priorities issued by Smart Nation and Digital Government Office / Ministry of Digital Development and Information, Singapore (smartnation.gov.sg) applicable to cloud service providers and operators.
relationToAISecurity: Addresses strategic emerging technology governance, AI security/capability priorities, and national resilience policy for Smart Nation and Digital Government Office / Ministry of Digital Development and Information, Singapore (smartnation.gov.sg).
